note: Three base strands, one weft. Weft is the background colour. Knot letters are listed in the order they are TIED, so row 2 starts at the right-hand edge.

rows.why: weft is the left strand of each pair going right, so B shows the base (design) and F shows the weft (background)
coming back the weft is the right strand, so B shows the weft (background) and F shows the base (design); tied right to left the wants are BG, D, D
